tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 2: Distance accumulator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** DistanceAccumulator sums distance and builds the route, ignoring GPS jumps and movement while paused.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/DistanceAccumulator.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/DistanceAccumulatorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Eleven fixes 3 m apart sum to 30 m with 11 route points
- [ ] Fixes implying over 10 m/s are ignored
- [ ] Paused fixes move the reference only
- [ ] Fixes with no elapsed time are ignored

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter DistanceAccumulatorTests

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-outdoor-gps.md


tasks.subject: Task 3: Pace window and mile splits
tasks.description:
**Goal:** PaceSmoother reports pace over the last 15 s; SplitTracker times each mile with interpolation.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/PaceSmoother.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/SplitTracker.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PaceSmootherTests.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/SplitTrackerTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 3 m/s gives 536 s/mi; window shows only the last 15 s (402)
- [ ] No pace standing still, under 5 s, or after reset
- [ ] Splits 502, 474 and a 24 s partial of 81.312 m
- [ ] Two miles in one update give 488 and 488; partial under 16 m dropped

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter PaceSmootherTests and --filter SplitTrackerTests

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-outdoor-gps.md

```json:metadata
{"files":["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/PaceSmoother.swift","RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/SplitTracker.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PaceSmootherTests.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/SplitTrackerTests.swift"],"verifyCommand":"swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter PaceSmootherTests and --filter SplitTrackerTests","acceptanceCriteria":["3 m/s gives 536 s/mi; window shows only the last 15 s (402)","No pace standing still, under 5 s, or after reset","Splits 502, 474 and a 24 s partial of 81.312 m","Two miles in one update give 488 and 488; partial under 16 m dropped"]}
```
